change: Mode3 authenticates complete joint wrapper, extended source descriptor and full rolling inputs before any derived header read, then reuses that fresh proof for embedded lineage roles.
proofBoundary: Complete numeric spans plus checked C prefix/member layout imply child coverage. Original exact owner identity, self, input, wrapper, constructor/backlink, activation and lifetime checks remain; modes0/2 retain their original paths. No cross-call cache, authority grant, callback, allocation, work budget, deadline or musical scheduling change.

comparisonObservation.scope: Repeated function calls on the genuine fixtures plus temporary restored scalar controls; these are not independent cases or a native cost measurement.
comparisonObservation.restorationBoundary: Base-owner prefix compared byte-for-byte; wrapper length and joint fields outside it are manually restored. Standalone rolling-scope calls retain ordinary fixture coverage without separate old/new comparison.

declinedPrivateProposal.reason: Moving the previous rolling proof before outer full-parent checks could read an inaccessible rolling header. Protected-page HOST observation reproduced a read fault; that proposal was never committed or target-executed.

independentReview.scope: Read-only source/pre-read ordering/predicate and frozen-reference review
independentReview.limits: Finite HOST controls do not exhaust arbitrary guarded topologies; direct rolling calls are not dual-compared and restoration snapshot covers the base prefix.
